nodes.text: RNA-seq Differential Transcript Usage (rnaseqDTU). Bioc Workflow `rnaseqDTU` analog: quantify transcripts (Salmon), import via tximport, then + DEXSeq + stageR for differential transcript usage with FDR control.

Microarray Normalization Method Comparison (ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow). Bioc Workflow ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow analog: read raw microarray CEL/IDAT files, normalize with multiple methods (RMA, vsn, lumi, ComBat), compare normalization quality via PCA and variance estimation. For normalization quality comparison and method selection ONLY — NOT for differential expression statistical testing. For differential expression analysis from a normalized microarray count matrix, use nf-core/differentialabundance.

RNA-seq + Epigenomic Integration (fluentGenomics). Bioc Workflow `fluentGenomics` analog: integrate RNA-seq differential genes with ATAC-seq accessibility regions and ChIP-seq TF binding peaks, link peaks to genes via + .
Run a complete rare disease workup — I have WES and RNA-seq

Identify tumor-reactive T cells in scRNA-seq data | single-cell RNA-seq phenotypic and clonotypic analysis to identify tumor-reactive CD8+ T cells via activation, exhaustion, and residency markers (e.g., CXCL13, ENTPD1, ITGAE) → annotated reactive T cell populations

Predict tumor neoantigens and MHC-binding peptides | neoantigen prediction pipeline identifying somatic missense/indel peptide candidates and predicting peptide-MHC binding affinities and presentation across patient HLA alleles → prioritized neoantigen candidate table
Perturb-seq guide assignment and barcode demultiplexing | sgRNA guide assignment and cell barcode demultiplexing from single-cell Perturb-seq data → AnnData object with cell-to-guide assignments

Perturb-seq hit calling and differential perturbation effect testing | statistical hit calling and differential expression testing between targeting guides and non-targeting controls → hit significance table and perturbation effect sizes

Perturbation state representation and embedding using scVI and scANVI | deep generative representation learning of single-cell perturbation states using scVI and scANVI → latent embeddings and low-dimensional perturbation space

IDAT → Normalisation → Differential Methylation → Gene Enrichment. EPIC/450K array methylation from IDAT — minfi load + functional normalisation, DSS differential methylation, missMethyl gene-set enrichment. Use when you want the DSS-based differential-methylation + enrichment wrapper chain. Also applicable to bismark bisulfite coverage from nf-core/methylseq.
predict CYP450 inhibition and hepatic clearance for new chemical entity
Run RNA-seq analysis and differential expression

BioMate: Subworkflow Sprint 3 — Pseudotime + RNA velocity from single-cell data Runs two orthogonal trajectory methods in parallel: — graph-based pseudotime (R / Monocle3) — RNA velocity (Python / scVelo) Both processes accept the same AnnData h5ad input but are. 2-step pipeline: → . Inputs: csv, h5ad. Outputs: anndata, csv, h5ad, png. Key parameters: adata_h5ad, monocle_cluster, root_cell, velocity_mode.

Nanostring GeoMx DSP Analysis (GeoMxWorkflows). Bioc Workflow `GeoMxWorkflows` analog: read Nanostring GeoMx DSP NanoStringGeoMxSet, segment-level QC, Q3 normalization, mixed-model linear DE across regions of interest.
FDA Phase II to Phase III dose justification brief

Public RNA-seq Reanalysis (recountWorkflow). Bioc Workflow `recountWorkflow` analog: pull uniformly-processed counts from recount2/3 for a study (e.g., SRP), scale counts by read length, run DESeq2 DE with technical replicate handling.

Estimate human PK parameters from rat, mouse, or dog preclinical data via allometric scaling | interspecies allometric scaling of preclinical pharmacokinetic parameters (CL, Vd) from animal species to project human baseline PK

Full PBPK simulation with compartmental model, organ-specific clearance, and special population impairment submodels | mechanistic whole-body physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulation with organ clearance and renal/hepatic impairment disease states

Monte Carlo population simulation for pharmacokinetic variability characterization | population PBPK Monte Carlo simulation sampling physiological and clearance variability to determine exposure distributions

Illumina 450k/EPIC Methylation Array DMR Analysis (methylationArrayAnalysis). Bioc Workflow `methylationArrayAnalysis` analog: read IDAT files via minfi, QC, normalize (SWAN or noob), call DMPs (limma), DMRs (DMRcate), gene-set test (missMethyl).

RNA-seq processing and differential expression analysis to generate transcriptional signature | differential gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq data → ranked gene signature with log2 fold changes and p-values

Query drug perturbation database (LINCS L1000/CMap) using the transcriptional signature to identify candidate drugs | transcriptional connectivity analysis querying drug perturbation profiles (LINCS L1000) with input gene signature → ranked drug compounds and mechanism of action
Run Voyager spatial ESDA on this Visium dataset
test compound effect over time at 0, 6, 24, and 72 hours

Population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) estimation pipeline with NONMEM primary execution and automatic nlmixr2 (R) fallback when NONMEM is unavailable. BYOL (Bring Your Own License) pattern: -- If NONMEM_HOME and NONMEM_LICENSE_FILE are set → run NONMEM nmfe75/nmfe74 -- Otherwise → fall back to nlmixr2 open-source R implementation Pipeline Steps: 1. -- Validate NONMEM-format dataset structure (ID, TIME, DV, etc.) 2. NONMEM_CTL_GENERATE -- Generate NO

Validate expression count matrix and clinical metadata | data validation and quality check of bulk RNA-seq gene expression matrix and matched sample clinical metadata table → verified matrix and metadata

Run limma-voom differential expression analysis adjusting for covariates | differential gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq count matrix using limma-voom transformation with covariate modeling and empirical Bayes moderation → per-gene logFC, t-statistics, and adjusted p-values

Perform GSVA/ssGSEA pathway enrichment on MSigDB hallmark gene sets | single-sample gene set variation analysis using GSVA or ssGSEA with 50 MSigDB hallmark gene sets on normalized expression data → sample pathway enrichment score matrix and top enriched pathways per group
Validate SMILES input file (one SMILES+ID per line) | chemical structure validation and sanitization of input SMILES strings with identifiers → validated SMILES file

RDKit RECAP decomposition into scaffold and R-groups | chemical fragmentation and RECAP decomposition of molecular structures into scaffolds and R-groups → fragmented molecular fragments and scaffolds

Matched molecular pair analysis using mmpdb to compute property deltas for fragment swaps | matched molecular pair indexing and analysis using mmpdb to compute property deltas for chemical fragment transformations → matched molecular pairs database

Rank novel scaffolds by frequency, drug-likeness, and SA score | cheminformatics scoring and ranking of candidate scaffolds by recurrence frequency, drug-likeness filters, and synthetic accessibility score → prioritized novel scaffold table

Phase A: Systemic exposure and physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulation to establish unbound peak plasma concentrations (Cmax,u) and tissue partition profiles | physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulation of compound systemic exposure, organ biodistribution, and unbound peak plasma concentration (Cmax,u) → PK profile and exposure parameters

Phase B: Cardiovascular core battery assessment simulating hERG and multi-ion channel inhibition, cardiac action potential duration (APD90), and hemodynamic parameters | in silico cardiovascular safety assessment across cardiac ion channels (hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2) and ventricular action potential modeling → APD90 prolongation, QTc risk, and proarrhythmic torsadogenic potential

Phase C: Central nervous system (CNS) and respiratory system core battery simulation assessing neurofunctional indicators, BBB permeability, and ventilatory mechanics | in silico central nervous system and respiratory safety pharmacology profiling including blood-brain barrier penetration, neuroreceptor cross-reactivity, and ventilatory function disruption → CNS and respiratory hazard scores

Phase D: Integrated ICH S7A safety pharmacology margin calculation, risk synthesis, and regulatory documentation dossier generation | integrated safety pharmacology risk assessment and margin calculation (exposure vs functional toxicity thresholds) complying with ICH S7A guidelines → safety pharmacology margin dossier and regulatory compliance card
